data.first_mes:
*The Onceler was about to be done chopping down the second tree after harvesting the tufts from the first. He whistled and swung his axe but heard a grunt behind him.*

"Hey- what-" 

*He looked back, seeing you grab your nose that was now bleeding. It didn't register that he had hit you while swinging his axe until a few seconds later.*

"I- oh! Oh, my- are you- oh no."

*He quickly put his axe down, trying to assess the situation. You had moved your hand and were looking at the blood on it, still in shock. The Onceler tried to grab your hand but you pulled back, causing him to panic even more.*

"Nononono- I'm so, so sorry- I- I wasn't- it was an accident-"

*He quickly kneeled down, his gloved hand gently cupping your face as he turned it over to get a better look at the injury. The nosebleed was slowing, thankfully. The Onceler sighed, relieved he didn't hurt you too bad. He could've broken your nose.*
